name: Concealed copper piping
tagline: Pre-installation piping hidden in walls and ceilings
summary: Concealed copper, drain and electrical lines laid before plastering or false ceiling work.
description: For new homes and interiors, running AC piping inside walls or ceilings keeps everything neat. We lay insulated copper lines, drain pipes and power cables at the right stage of construction, pressure test them, and seal the ends so the AC can be fitted cleanly later.
duration: Half a day to 2 days, depending on the number of points
suitable_for: New homes, villas, offices and interior fit-outs
includes: Point planning for indoor and outdoor units
Insulated copper piping in walls or ceilings
Concealed drain lines with proper slope
Nitrogen pressure test and capped ends
Coordination with civil and interior teams
signs: You're building or renovating a home
You want no visible pipes on the walls
Interior work or false ceiling is being planned

process.title: Plan points
process.text: We mark indoor, outdoor and drain positions with you.

process.title: Lay piping
process.text: Copper, drain and cable are laid before plastering.

process.title: Final fitting
process.text: When the ACs arrive, units are connected and commissioned.

faqs.question: When should concealed piping be done?
faqs.answer: Before plastering, or before the false ceiling is closed. Talk to us at the brickwork stage.

faqs.question: What if a concealed pipe leaks later?
faqs.answer: That's why we pressure-test every line before it's covered, and use proper brazing and insulation.
